abstract.t: Autonomous System Provider Authorization (ASPA) provides a Resource Public Key Infrastructure (RPKI)-based mechanism for verifying the Border Gateway Protocol (BGP) AS_PATH attribute to detect route leaks and certain forms of AS_PATH manipulation. The performance of ASPA- based AS_PATH verification depends on several factors, including the size and structure of ASPA data, AS_PATH characteristics, verification procedures, and the interaction between ASPA updates and BGP routing operations. This document defines a benchmarking methodology for evaluating ASPA verification implementations on routing devices. The methodology specifies controlled test conditions and procedures for measuring ASPA data processing, AS_PATH verification performance, route revalidation, BGP convergence, scalability, and resource utilization. The objective is to provide repeatable and comparable measurements that characterize the performance and operational behavior of ASPA verification under varying conditions.
